description: This is a PHP test class for the LeaveAPI endpoint within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It contains test cases for API methods such as getAll, create, getOne, and delete, but the creation, retrieval, and deletion methods are marked as not implemented. The class uses a testing framework, mocks services, and loads test fixtures for API testing purposes.
